title: 第28章 融合第29章 渔舟
content_zh:
一般来说，每两宝鱼市价五十两纹银左右。
可一旦超过一斤那就是质变了，这种宝鱼被称之为鱼王，对突破化境都有极大好处，故而价值也会直线飙升，至少都是万两纹银起步。
眼前这三百多条金鳞宝鱼，大多数都不超过三两重，但是也有三条八九两重的准鱼王。
“一共一百七十三斤，按照市价来计算的话，那就是足足八万多两。”
称完重以后，陆沉心里有些发抖。
足足八万两白银，哪怕是内城的四大家族，都未必能轻易拿得出这么多钱。
“这么多资源，哪怕修至暗劲八响、九响，甚至冲击化境应该都绰绰有余了。”
陆沉心中激动，又查看宝药。
宝药跟宝鱼有不同，主要以年份论价值。
一般宝药药力每多一年，价值就会提升一大截，十年份以上的宝药更是能让化境武人心动。
陆沉简单查过这些宝药，估算其价值应该不少于五万两白银。
“可惜只拿走了一半，不然怕是得有十万两白银。”
陆沉摇了摇头，然后又深吸了一口气。
他把各种宝药放在厨房用火烘干，然后开始处理这些宝鱼。
他将宝鱼一个个开膛破肚清洗干净，然后再用准备好的大量粗盐腌制，最后放在了后院晾干。
“接下来一个星期，在这些宝鱼晾干储存之前，我都不能离开后院了。”
陆沉心中低语，拿起一个宝鱼烤熟吃了下去，然后开始修炼铁甲功。
结果刚练没多久，陆沉就面色骤变地跑向茅厕。
“该死，巴豆放多了。”
片刻后，陆沉从茅厕出来，脸上有些青白不定，看着这些宝鱼顿时有些不香了。

这巴豆放太多，导致这些宝鱼吃下去是个煎熬。
好在有生命星辰在，陆沉拉完之后也很快恢复，倒也没有落得个虚脱的下场。
只是每次吃完，都要去拉一段时间，实在是煎熬得很。
“能不断修复，倒也不一定非要去茅厕，只是吃下后持续腹痛难忍，着实有些煎熬。”
陆沉满脸苦笑，又将这些宝鱼再次清洗了几遍，这才重新腌制晾晒起来。
只是这些宝鱼早已被巴豆腌入味了，想要彻底去除亦是不可能，陆沉仍然要承受不小的麻烦。
“罢了，为了变强，些许巴豆又算什么!”
“就当是一场修行吧。”
陆沉犹豫很久，咬牙将宝鱼吃了下去。
有了充足资源，加上每日不间断苦练八个时辰，他一日修行抵得上常人数个月苦修，功力与各种武学的进展都开始突飞猛进。
短短一个月后，裂石拳就被他修炼到了圆满层次。
可惜裂石拳只是不入流武学，哪怕修至圆满也就能修成暗劲一响。
而自从裂石拳圆满之后，其他几道武学进展也开始快速提升，仅仅半个月就将烈火功、铁砂掌、六合腿修至圆满层次。
……
“呼哈！”
这一日，后院之中。
陆沉赤着上身，硬桥硬马扎着马步。
阳光下，古铜色的肌肤泛着金属般的光泽。
content_en:
Generally speaking, the market price of each tael of fish is about fifty taels of silver.
But once it exceeds one kilogram, it is a qualitative change. This kind of treasure fish is called the king of fish, which is of great benefit to breaking through the realm of transformation, so the value will skyrocket, at least starting from ten thousand taels of silver.
Most of the more than 300 golden-scaled treasure fish in front of me were no more than three or two weights, but there were also three quasi-fish kings of eight or ninety-two weights.
"A total of one hundred and seventy-three kilograms. If calculated according to the market price, it would be more than eighty thousand taels."
After weighing himself, Lu Chen felt a little trembling.
A full eighty thousand taels of silver, even the four major families in the inner city may not be able to easily come up with so much money.
"With so many resources, it should be more than enough to cultivate to the eighth or ninth ring of dark energy, or even to the realm of transformation."
Lu Chen was excited and checked the treasure medicine again.
Treasure medicine is different from treasure fish. The value is mainly determined by the year.
Generally speaking, the value of a precious medicine will increase greatly for every additional year, and the value of a precious medicine that is more than ten years old can even make a warrior's heart flutter.
Lu Chen briefly checked these precious medicines and estimated that their value should be no less than 50,000 taels of silver.
"It's a pity that I only took half of it, otherwise I might have had one hundred thousand taels of silver."
Lu Chen shook his head, and then took a deep breath.
He put various treasures in the kitchen to dry over fire, and then began to process these treasures.
He disemboweled and cleaned the treasure fish one by one, then marinated them with a large amount of prepared coarse salt, and finally placed them in the backyard to dry.
"I couldn't leave the backyard for the next week until the fish were dried and stored."
Lu Chen whispered in his heart, picked up a treasure fish, grilled it, ate it, and then began to practice the iron armor skill.
As a result, not long after practicing, Lu Chen's expression suddenly changed and he ran to the toilet.
“Damn, there’s too much croton.”
After a while, Lu Chen came out of the toilet, his face a little pale and pale, and he felt a little unsatisfied looking at these precious fish.
There are too many crotons, which makes eating these treasures a torture.
Fortunately, with the Life Star, Lu Chen recovered quickly after finishing the exercise, and did not end up exhausted.
It's just that every time I eat, I have to go to the toilet for a while, which is really painful.
"It can be repaired continuously, and you don't necessarily have to go to the toilet. It's just that the abdominal pain persists after eating it, which is really a bit painful."
With a wry smile on his face, Lu Chen washed the precious fish several times before marinating them again and drying them in the sun.
However, these precious fish have already been marinated in croton, and it is impossible to completely remove them. Lu Chen still has to endure a lot of trouble.
"That's all, in order to become stronger, a little croton is nothing!"
"Just think of it as a spiritual practice."
Lu Chen hesitated for a long time, gritted his teeth and ate the treasure fish.
With sufficient resources and eight hours of non-stop hard training every day, his one-day practice was equivalent to months of hard work for ordinary people, and his skills and progress in various martial arts began to improve by leaps and bounds.
In just one month, he had cultivated the Rock Splitting Fist to a perfect level.
It's a pity that the Stone Splitting Fist is not a martial art, even if it is practiced to perfection, it can still be cultivated into An Jin Yi Xiang.
Since the completion of the Stone Splitting Fist, several other martial arts progresses have also begun to improve rapidly. In just half a month, the Fire Kung Fu, Iron Sand Palm, and Liuhe Kung have been cultivated to a perfect level.
…
"Huha!"
On this day, in the backyard.
Lu Chen's upper body was naked, and he was riding hard on his horse.
Under the sun, the bronzed skin glowed with a metallic sheen.
